rules: Authored before any scoring run against this set, after the tool-result failure note and scorer corrections that followed the holdout5 gate failure; never use it to tune prompts, retrieval, policies or scorer thresholds.
A run on this set is a gate. Any edit to holdout6.json changes the hash and must be a deliberate, reviewed re-freeze with a new date and a note here.
Disjoint from development.json, evaluation.json, holdout.json, holdout2.json, holdout3.json, holdout4.json and holdout5.json (ids, domains, business questions).
limitations: 45 cases in 5 small-business domains, English only, single provider/model per run: not a general measure of answer quality.
Pattern/substring checks are a proxy; a human rubric review of a sample is still required (docs/evidence/l1.4). noDenial cases assume the case's own knowledge is silent on the asked offering.
supersedes: holdout5 (consumed 2026-11-02: gate failed on failed-tool disclosure 86.7% and the scorer's time-promise rule; the engine and scorer were changed after seeing those results).
